chapter: Highlights, the reunion album and fellow musicians
title: Japan and Dud Bascomb's reports
summary: Dud and Sam Taylor told him Japan knew him; he has not been.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Have you had a chance to get out to Japan and the East?
No, I haven't. I would like to go out.
Dud Bascomb used to come back. He used to go there a lot with.......
Dud used to come back and tell me, he'd say Hawk, you've got to go. He said the people keep asking about you over there. You know? And I said perhaps one of these days, you know, like that.

But, he used to, everytime he'd go over there, he used to come back and tell me about the tour when he and Sam "the Man" were there. And, he used to tell me about the people. He'd say they know all about you over there. Dud used to give me all the information when he'd go out there.
Now, Sam, to tell you about Sam "the Man". Sam "the Man" was down to Birmingham on this, came down there on that same show I did down there.
Yeah. He came in with the big band. He did 10 or 15 minutes with his act. You know, cause I had to do, the show was running about 2 hours. Yeah. He was on that
show. And that's the first time I seen him since he's been sick.
